d: We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead and manage large-scale cybersecurity projects from initiation through completion and handover. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing project delivery, ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and contractual requirements.

The role requires strong experience in managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects, with the ability to coordinate cybersecurity and ICT deployments alongside construction activities, site readiness, civil works, MEP, and infrastructure development.

The candidate will act as the primary point of coordination between the customer, technical teams, vendors, subcontractors, and project stakeholders to ensure successful project execution and delivery.
